about: Task 5 of the BBC Micro models plan: every part on the Issue 7 board, placed on the bare scans' footprints (registration.json) in the board frame (frame.json), named from table 8.1 of the Service Manual (D1, through ic-table.json), and checked against the manual's places and the markings on I5; I6 read and recorded. Written by board_parts.py; every figure here is a measurement made on the date of the journal entry that quotes it. `model` is what site/src/models/bbc-micro-board-parts.mjs exports.

identities.what: Each IC's marking read by hand on a crop (marks.json parts.identities), against table 8.1's part by the rule fixed before any crop was read (board_parts.py, step 4); I6 recorded, not judged

manual.what: Table 8.1's places (mm from the SW corner, Y towards the rear) against each IC's point on the board under the convention settled on IC51, IC52, IC20 and IC21 alone, after the similarity fitted to every placed IC with a place in the table (the manual's Y flipped); none may be more than 10 mm off

axial.what: typical, not measured: an axial part lying on the board: its body's diameter

board.what: typical, not measured: the board's thickness, the usual for a two-layer board

crystal.what: typical, not measured: a crystal can lying flat

dType.what: typical, not measured: the 15-way D socket's housing

din.what: typical, not measured: a DIN socket's housing

dip.what: typical, not measured: a plastic DIP seated on the board, to the top of its body

header.what: typical, not measured: a pin header

idc.what: typical, not measured: a boxed header with latches

modulator.what: typical, not measured: the UHF modulator's can

phono.what: typical, not measured: the modulator's output socket

radial.what: typical, not measured: a disc or dipped capacitor standing on its leads

relay.what: typical, not measured: the cassette motor's relay

socket.what: typical, not measured: what a socket adds under a DIP

drives the disc drive's lines (open collector)
drives the disc drive's lines (open collector)
separates the disc's data (a digital monostable, with IC82)
separates the disc's data (a digital monostable, with IC81)
detects the disc drive's index pulses (with IC84 and IC85)
detects the disc drive's index pulses (with IC83 and IC85)
detects the disc drive's index pulses (with IC83 and IC84)
divides the 8 MHz clock to 31.25 kHz for the disc interface
shapes the disc drive's read pulses (a monostable)
a sideways ROM socket: the DFS

others.label: the UHF modulator (Astec UM1233 E36, as I5 shows it)

overhang.what: Connector and other bodies that run past the board's outline, as I5 shows them

passives.what: Two-lead parts inferred from the print: pairs of free pads with print along the line between them (board_parts.py, step 7); typical bodies

sheila.from: D1 PDF page 58, "DEFPROC strobe select lines" (each SHEILA address and the IC pin its select line reaches); the sound chip, IC18, is written through the system VIA (docs/bbc-micro/facts/via.md)

thresholds.i5Registration: I5 to the board frame on chip pins, each chip held out: median at most 1.0 mm passes, over 2.0 mm stops
thresholds.identities: every IC's marking read on I5 is table 8.1's part by the fixed rule (ROM sockets not compared), and at least three quarters of the ICs I5 shows populated are read; under that, not measured
thresholds.inside: every IC body and every two-lead part inside the outline; a connector or other part over it is recorded
thresholds.manual: after a best-fit similarity, no placed IC more than 10 mm from table 8.1's place, on the convention settled first
thresholds.padCounts: every placed IC's pad count is its part's pin count; a fitted IC not placed fails
